scope.instructions: Select the delivery boundary most consistent with complete runnable replacement of the requested tests.

criteria.retarget_minimal: Use the 25-file Manolea inventory as authority, carry over pertinent Can pieces, implement only necessary native execution support, conserve probe coverage and leave extraneous Can-suite migration for another effort.
criteria.finish_existing: Continue the entire 143-item Can programme to acceptance of its 292 rows and retirement prerequisites as a compulsory precursor to any Manolea conversion.
criteria.host_verdicts: Place test scenarios and judgments in reusable TypeScript outside the test directory and use Can as a launch wrapper, trading away responsibility for scenario/verdict logic.

fixtures.instructions: Choose a duplication remedy that saves generation and reading effort while maintaining independent test outcomes.

criteria.existing_updates: Author baseline-plus-with changes with current Can features; verify targeted values and refusal IDs independently, retain exact protocol fixture bytes and keep one authoritative provenance record checked for omissions and source drift.
criteria.new_syntax: Extend assertion syntax with fixture templates and introduce further abstraction machinery ahead of trimming the current repeated constructors and metadata returns.
criteria.keep_clones: Preserve the expanded full observations and doubled manifest values for all cases as obligatory evidence, even where the purported cross-check shares its generator.

sequence.instructions: Choose the schedule that most directly tests whether a replacement genuinely exercises its product.

criteria.vertical_live: Deliver one working Manolea case across dispatch, ownership, native action, external facts and defect detection before scaling separate port lanes with batch evidence.
criteria.static_first: Complete remaining literal campaign source and row-by-row audit prose first, postponing live runner implementation and approval until afterwards.
criteria.waive_execution: Accept static self-consistency as the migration verdict and remove the prior live test entries without equivalent actual executions.
